title: Hearty Smoky Kenyan Lamb Stew
description: A smoky and pillowy Kenyan dish featuring juniper berries, this stew is perfect for a flexitarian-friendly meal, especially during the monsoon season.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until it is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the lamb and cook until it is browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the juniper berries, smoked paprika, and beef broth, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Add the potatoes and continue to simmer for 30 minutes, or until they are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
